definitions.explanation: stakeholder; a person or group with an interest or concern in a business, project, or organization

examples.japanese: ステークホルダーの{意見|いけん}を{聞|き}く。
{全|すべ}てのステークホルダーに{説明|せつめい}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: We need to explain to all stakeholders.

examples.japanese: ステークホルダーとの{関係|かんけい}{構築|こうちく}が{重要|じゅうよう}だ。
examples.english: Building relationships with stakeholders is important.

notes:
ステークホルダー is a business term from English "stakeholder," referring to anyone with an interest in a company or project.

TYPES OF STAKEHOLDERS:
- {株主|かぶぬし} (shareholders)
- {従業員|じゅうぎょういん} (employees)
- {顧客|こきゃく} (customers)
- {取引先|とりひきさき} (business partners)
- {地域|ちいき}{社会|しゃかい} (local community)
- {行政|ぎょうせい} (government)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ステークホルダー{分析|ぶんせき} (stakeholder analysis)
- ステークホルダー{管理|かんり} (stakeholder management)
- ステークホルダー{エンゲージメント|えんげーじめんと} (stakeholder engagement)

BUSINESS CONTEXT:
Used frequently in:
- {経営|けいえい} (management) discussions
- CSR ({企業|きぎょう}の{社会的|しゃかいてき}{責任|せきにん})
- プロジェクト{管理|かんり} (project management)
- {投資家|とうしか}{向|む}け{説明|せつめい} (investor relations)

JAPANESE EQUIVALENT:
- {利害関係者|りがいかんけいしゃ} (interested party) - more formal native term

REGISTER: Formal. Business and corporate vocabulary.
